name: poly-fanout
description: Fan saved chord extras out at the real melodic pair call site 0x080217F4. Track is resolved deterministically by matching [voice+8] (parent) against the three track pointers at 0x20000450. The poly record must contain the exact primary note; extras are emitted unchanged with stock time/duration/routing and the original selector. Tail-branches to 0x08019A92 so the primary keeps its return value.

patches.note: real pair call -> chord fan-out cave
